metadata_version: "1.1"
id: gcp-storage-public-access-prevention
version: 1.0.0
title: Cloud Storage buckets enforce public access prevention
severity: high
services: [storage]
resource_types: [storage.googleapis.com/Bucket]
capabilities: {detect: true, gate: true, enforce: false}
gate:
  establishes: complete
  normalisers:
    - {input_kind: terraform_plan, file: google_storage_bucket.rego}
  directive: directive.json
crosswalk:
  - {framework_id: cis-gcp-2.0, control_id: "5.2", control_title: Ensure that Cloud Storage buckets have public access prevention enforced}
authored_by: acse_pack

package acse.classes.gcp_storage_public_access_prevention

import rego.v1

result := "fail" if input.facts.public_access_prevention_enforced == false

result := "pass" if input.facts.public_access_prevention_enforced == true

metadata_version: "1.1"
id: cust-bucket-retention
version: 2.1.0
title: Buckets keep objects for the minimum retention
severity: medium
services: [storage]
resource_types: [storage.googleapis.com/Bucket]
capabilities: {detect: true, gate: true, enforce: false}
gate:
  establishes: partial
  normalisers:
    - {input_kind: terraform_plan, file: Bucket.rego}
    - {input_kind: terraform_plan, file: bucket_policy.rego}
params_schema:
  params:
    - {name: minimum_days, kind: integer, required: true, minimum: 1, tightens: raise}
    - {name: allowed_regions, kind: region_list, required: false}
authored_by: customer_studio

package acse.classes.cust_bucket_retention

import rego.v1

result := "fail" if input.facts.retention_days < data.params.minimum_days
